A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TRSP and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. All 15 pages of v2 and 17 pages of v3 support comparison, including matching retained material across layout changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original pruning experiments, including perplexity, zero-shot accuracy, acceleration, ablations, and appendix sensitivity results.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds Llama-2-70B results and comparisons across pruning granularities in Tables 10–11.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and the two-stage procedure remain unchanged: iterative layer-weight learning, input-output regularization, and layer removal. Appendix I explains the existing procedure without introducing a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same generation datasets and five zero-shot benchmarks, including appendix evaluations. The added Llama-2-70B experiments retain these tasks and datasets; they extend model configurations rather than task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 11 adds evaluated Wanda with 2:4 sparsity and SliceGPT comparisons, substantially broadening the reported comparison beyond layer pruning. Both were previously cited, but v2 contains no corresponding results. Table 10 separately extends the existing SLEB, ShortGPT, LaCo, and Shortened LLaMA comparator set to 70B.

E3.justification: Appendices G–H add a Llama-2-70B configuration and a comparison using Wanda's 2:4 pattern alongside 25% layer and channel pruning. They otherwise inherit Section 4.2's data and evaluation settings. Previously reported protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The pruning-ratio, calibration-data, retraining-budget, component-ablation, hyperparameter, and layer-similarity analyses are retained unchanged. Appendices G–H add benchmark comparisons, while Appendix I supplies interpretation without a separately documented new ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. The added tables continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 and existing figure results are unchanged. New Tables 10–11 substantially extend the results to 70B and additional pruning granularities: TRSP-l2 at 25% layer pruning reports 4.13 perplexity, 74.32% average accuracy, 1.38× throughput, and 1.36× speedup. These are additional configurations, not improvements to earlier runs. Appendix I also newly asserts nearly unchanged modeling loss during regularization without quantification.

T1.justification: Proposition 3.1, its Appendix A proof, and Equations 1–9 are unchanged. Despite its theoretical-analysis heading, Appendix I repeats Equation 4 as Equation 10 and adds a conceptual argument rather than a new mathematical derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: knowledge preservation through two-stage regularization, superiority over layer-pruning baselines, acceleration, and no post-pruning retraining. The rewritten contribution bullet does not materially alter their scope.

C2.justification: Appendix I adds an identity-mapping and competing-objectives explanation, treating nearly unchanged modeling loss as confirmation of knowledge preservation and transfer. Appendix H interprets the new comparisons as a favorable performance–efficiency tradeoff across pruning granularities. The existing limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3's abstract newly supplies a TRSP code-repository link. Appendix B and Table 6 retain the same implementation settings. The added 70B experiments refer to existing settings without specifying their execution configuration.

R1.justification: v3 adds a DLP citation in related work and several introductory citations on reasoning, multimodal models, routing, and distillation. Appendix H adds comparison-based positioning against other pruning granularities, while the main pruning and regularization framing remains intact.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited paragraph and contribution-bullet edits, updates authorship and affiliations, adds acknowledgments, and renames Appendix F from 'Example Appendix' to 'Cosine Similarity.' Appendices G–I extend the document, but the retained narrative is largely unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 10–11, relocates existing displays, and adds metric-direction arrows to Table 2. It corrects Figure 8's unrelated caption to describe unregularized-layer similarity. All eight figure graphics remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The 70B evaluation and additional pruning comparisons extend the empirical support beyond v2, while the code link and corrected Figure 8 caption improve usability. The gains are limited by unspecified 70B execution details and differing sparsity settings in Table 11. Appendix I also overstates what nearly unchanged modeling loss establishes about knowledge preservation.
